title: Design Release 2: the admin on the tokens, one command header
why: Jason's platform-wide directive (design/css-theme-brand.md §1–4, Release 2), on Release 1's tokens (#146). (1) THE ADMIN KIT (app/admin/kit-css.php) has no colour of its own: cards are the parchment micro-gradient, inputs the vellum, lines and metadata text the mixed tokens; OK text is Faded Forest Moss with Warm Near-Black (6.75:1), since no brand green passes as text; 150ms ease-out; headings in the heading serif. (2) ONE COMMAND HEADER replacing the sage bar and peach tab of 2026-11-12, its layout kept: one Deep Umber row joined to the site's top bar. Back (copper), the module, the sections menu and the page's own filter on the left; the board's light, At hand and Shortcuts on the right. One row on a wide screen, two on a phone (three before). The one search stays the header's Ctrl K box; a list's own box filters only that list. A page moves its filter or utility row up into the header with data-ak-cmd (left) or data-ak-cmd="right"; opt-in. (3) THE RECORD STRIP (command-strip.php) in the same look. (4) TWO FIXES: both bars stuck 34px too low (the account bar counted twice) and covered the first card; they now stick at the measured bottom of what's pinned above them. On a phone, the sections menu ran off the right edge; it now spans the screen, and a long section name is cut with an ellipsis. (5) SPACE between groups (1.5rem), never inside list rows. FAQ: a new entry on the bar; the admin has 10 modules, not 11.

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
